description: Return an anonymous complyonsite.com link that opens a waste transfer note, hazardous waste consignment note or RAMS ready to fill in, plus the blank template and a worked example as ready-made PDFs. Waste-note links prefill validated EWC codes; RAMS links select a job and optional supported operation. The person completes, signs and downloads the document on the site. The tool does not create, save, sign, issue or submit a document.
